text: TEMPLATE. Copy this entry, then: give it the next id (higher than every id below), keep only the targets it applies to, set the date, write the text, and remove the draft line. Nothing with draft true is ever shown. The Android app counts as website. The date is optional and is only a heading, so an entry without one still shows. IMPORTANT: only the NEWEST entry a client has not seen is shown as the message, and everything older goes behind the collapsed row. So write ONE entry per client per release, carrying everything that client needs to hear. Two entries for the same release, split by target, buries one of them. A line starting with a bullet, a hyphen or an asterisk becomes a real list item, so a long one wraps neatly under its own text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
Updates for Bookmark Manager Zero will be displayed like this going forward

Version 5.9 is here.

• Dragging is rebuilt. The scroll wheel now works while you hold an item, and dragging to the top or bottom edge of the list finally scrolls it.
• Every folder picker now shows your real folder tree instead of the previous list.
• Multi-select got three changes: new pleasant animations, each folder has a button that selects everything inside it, and folders open and close while you are in multi-select now.
• The multi-select button itself turns red while the mode is on for better guidance on how to exit the mode.
• A change covering more than 200 bookmarks was being cut short previously. It is no longer.
• Renaming a folder was never recorded as your own change, so the rename never reached your other devices via Gitlab sync. It does now.

Version 5.9 is here.

• You can now drag to reorder with a finger. Press and hold a bookmark or a folder, it lifts under your finger, and you drag it wherever you want it. Hold near the top or bottom of the list to scroll while you drag.
• Lift your finger without moving it to enter multi-select mode instead, and note that a long press no longer opens the menu.
• The status bar at the bottom of the screen is visible again in mobile Chrome and mobile Firefox.
• Dragging with a mouse is rebuilt too. The scroll wheel now works while you hold an item, and dragging to the top or bottom edge of the list finally scrolls it.
• Every folder picker now shows your real folder tree instead of the previous list.
• Multi-select got three changes: new pleasant animations, each folder has a button that selects everything inside it, and folders open and close while you are in multi-select now.
• The multi-select button itself turns red while the mode is on for better guidance on how to exit the mode.
• A change covering more than 200 bookmarks was being cut short previously. It is no longer.
• Renaming a folder was never recorded as your own change, so the rename never reached your other devices via Gitlab sync. It does now.
